title: CMTC workload protection
description: Is every Required workload protected, and if not, why not? The protection lifecycle step by step: namespace intent, capture and enrollment, policy sources, publication and acknowledgment, release, then traffic. Control-plane verdicts are prerequisites, never proof of protection.

panels.title: Which namespaces are meant to be protected?
Namespace decisions, per cluster
panels.description: What the CMTC controller decided for each namespace, per cluster, now. Selected is policy intent; Labelled counts namespaces carrying the enrollment label from any actor. Neither is protection.

panels.title: Enforcement verified by CMTC
panels.description: Whether CMTC can verify that the datapath enforces what it selected, per cluster. It is 0 in Observe mode by design (internal/telemetry/metrics.go): enforcement evidence comes from Cilium and ztunnel below.

panels.title: Pods observed on the Pod network
panels.description: Pods the CMTC node agents list on their nodes with Pod networking, per cluster. An inventory, not a count of protected Pods.

panels.title: How to read this section

options.content: Intent and inventory only: a selected namespace is not a protected one. The sections below follow each Required workload through the lifecycle.

panels.title: Is every Required workload released, and if not, why not? · planned
Required workloads released · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cilium/0002 (destinations by state). Share of Required workloads released from quarantine, per cluster, now. No data: no Required workload, or no agent built with the patch.

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster) (cilium_ztunnel_xds_effective_policy_destinations{job="cilium-native", state="released", cluster="cmtc-a"}) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (cilium_ztunnel_xds_effective_policy_destinations{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-a"})) / (sum by (cluster) (cilium_ztunnel_xds_effective_policy_destinations{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-a"}) > 0)

(sum by (cluster) (cilium_ztunnel_xds_effective_policy_destinations{job="cilium-native", state="released", cluster="cmtc-b"}) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (cilium_ztunnel_xds_effective_policy_destinations{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-b"})) / (sum by (cluster) (cilium_ztunnel_xds_effective_policy_destinations{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-b"}) > 0)

panels.title: Required workloads not released · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cilium/0002 (destinations by state). Required workloads still quarantined, per cluster, now. Normal: 0 once Pods have started. The table names the step each one is on.

panels.title: Required workloads by state, per node · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cilium/0002 (destinations by state). Required local workloads by the lifecycle step they are on, from the agent of each workload's node. Everything but released is a reason it is not protected yet; the agent log line "Required workload is not an effective ztunnel policy destination" names each Pod UID.

panels.title: How to read this section

options.content: Released is the control plane's verdict that every step completed, a prerequisite of protection. Proof comes from traffic, in the last section.

panels.title: Are Pods captured and enrolled?
ZDS connection from ztunnel, per node
panels.description: Whether each node's Cilium agent holds a ZDS connection from that node's ztunnel, over time. Without it new Pods are not enrolled and stay quarantined. A gap is no data for the node.

panels.title: ZDS enrollments per second
panels.description: Pods the Cilium agents enrolled with ztunnel over ZDS, per cluster, 5 minute rate. Steps follow Pod starts; 0 is normal when nothing starts.

panels.title: ZDS enrollment failures, 1 hour
panels.description: ZDS enrollment failures over the last hour, per cluster. Normal: 0. The series is created by its first failure, so the first one after an agent start is missed until source-patches/cilium/0001.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (increase(cilium_ztunnel_zds_enrollment_failures_total{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-a"}[1h])) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-a"} == 1)
sum by (cluster) (increase(cilium_ztunnel_zds_enrollment_failures_total{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-b"}[1h])) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-b"} == 1)

panels.title: In-Pod proxies waiting to start · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the ztunnel scrape job of deploy/. In-Pod proxies ztunnel has accepted but not started, per cluster, now. Normal: 0 (CMTCInPodProxiesPending after 5 minutes).

panels.title: ZDS enrollment failures in the last hour, by node and status
panels.description: The failures above by node and status: netns_failed and iptables_failed point at the Pod network namespace, uid_mismatch at a replaced Pod, send_failed at the ztunnel connection. Empty: no failure since the agents started.

panels.title: In-Pod proxies running · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the ztunnel scrape job of deploy/. In-Pod proxies ztunnel runs, per cluster, now: one per enrolled Pod.

panels.title: How to read this section

options.content: Enrollment hands a Pod to ztunnel; a running in-Pod proxy is the next step. Neither proves its traffic is protected.

panels.title: Which callers are admitted as policy sources?
Policy sources admitted, by node and origin
panels.description: Callers each node's agent admitted as effective policy sources at its last reconcile, by origin: node (local workloads), cluster (other nodes of the cluster) and peer (the other cluster). Every node of a cluster should read the same.

panels.title: Policy sources refused, by node, origin and reason · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cilium/0001 (refused sources). Callers the last reconcile refused, by reason class. Those callers are denied by every local destination. not_captured and no_egress_policy are normal while a caller starts.

panels.title: Plans republished because a caller was removed, per second · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cilium/0001 (publications by cause). Effective plans republished because a caller left them (a narrowing: the caller's egress no longer allows the destination, or it was deleted), per cluster, 5 minute rate.

panels.title: Plans published in the last hour, by cause · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cilium/0001 (publications by cause). Effective plans published by what changed: initial, address, native_policy, caller_removed, plan_changed.

panels.title: How to read this section

options.content: The admitted counts are the G1 signal deployed today. Refusals and narrowing need the Cilium patch.

panels.title: Are plans published to ztunnel and acknowledged?
Effective policies published per second
panels.description: Effective policies the agents published to ztunnel, per cluster, 5 minute rate.

panels.title: Effective policies acknowledged per second
panels.description: Publications ztunnel acknowledged on the same ADS stream, per cluster, 5 minute rate. It follows the published line; a lasting gap is a plan ztunnel has not applied.

panels.title: Effective policy events in the last hour, by event
panels.description: published, acknowledged, released, compile_failed and release_refused over the last hour. An event missing from the table did not happen since the agent started.

panels.title: Authorization updates in the last hour, by status
panels.description: Authorization (policy) updates the agents sent ztunnel, by result: ack, cancel, nack, send_failed. nack and send_failed are rejections (CMTCAuthorizationRejected).

panels.title: Oldest unacknowledged plan, seconds · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cilium/0001 (oldest unacknowledged). Age of the oldest published plan ztunnel has not acknowledged, per cluster. 0: none outstanding. Until ztunnel acknowledges, it enforces the previous plan (CMTCEffectivePolicyUnacknowledged above 60 s).

targets.expr: (time() - (max by (cluster) (cilium_ztunnel_xds_effective_policy_oldest_unacknowledged_timestamp_seconds{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-a"}) > 0)) or 0 * max by (cluster) (cilium_ztunnel_xds_effective_policy_oldest_unacknowledged_timestamp_seconds{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-a"})

(time() - (max by (cluster) (cilium_ztunnel_xds_effective_policy_oldest_unacknowledged_timestamp_seconds{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-b"}) > 0)) or 0 * max by (cluster) (cilium_ztunnel_xds_effective_policy_oldest_unacknowledged_timestamp_seconds{job="cilium-native", cluster="cmtc-b"})

panels.title: Publication to acknowledgment, 99th percentile, seconds · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cilium/0001 (acknowledgment histogram). Time from a publication to ztunnel's acknowledgment of it, all causes, per cluster, from the histogram over 5 minutes. No value when nothing was acknowledged in the window.

panels.title: How to read this section

options.content: Published and acknowledged lines move together when ztunnel keeps up. Release follows acknowledgment.

panels.title: Does every node know the peer cluster's workloads?
Peer-cluster workloads known, by node
panels.description: Workloads of the peer cluster each node's agent projected to its ztunnel, now. Every node of a cluster should read the same number.

panels.title: Remote projection events in the last hour, by event
panels.description: projected, withdrawn and stream_reset_for_recovery events of the peer-workload projection.

panels.title: How to read this section

options.content: A node that knows fewer peer workloads than its neighbours refuses their callers.

panels.title: Is protected traffic flowing? · proposed
Source mTLS connections attempted, 5 minutes · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the ztunnel scrape job of deploy/. Outbound mTLS connections the callers' ztunnels started in the last 5 minutes, per cluster. none: no workload connected, so there is nothing to judge, and no failure count below means healthy. During the outage of #34 no ztunnel of either lab counted a connection between 2026-10-27T00:01Z and 00:47Z (their /stats/prometheus pages, read twice). ztunnel counts a connection as opened when it builds its connection result, before the handshake, so every failed connection was also opened (src/proxy/metrics.rs:752-792, :881-902). Connections refused before that (unknown source workload, no route, a stale xDS generation) are only in the ztunnel access log, as "connection failed" (src/proxy/outbound.rs:193-226, metrics.rs:624-648).

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{job="ztunnel", reporter="source", connection_security_policy="mutual_tls", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="ztunnel", cluster="cmtc-a"} == 1)

sum by (cluster) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{job="ztunnel", reporter="source", connection_security_policy="mutual_tls", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) or 0 * max by (cluster) (up{job="ztunnel", cluster="cmtc-b"} == 1)

panels.title: mTLS connections opened per second, destination side · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the ztunnel scrape job of deploy/. Inbound mTLS connections the destination's ztunnel accepted, per cluster, 5 minute rate. Traffic evidence for the connection, not a verdict on the workload.

panels.title: Failed share of source mTLS connections · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the ztunnel scrape job of deploy/. Outbound mTLS connections that failed, as a share of those attempted, as the caller's ztunnel counts them, per cluster, 5 minute rate. Normal: 0. No line: nothing was attempted in the window (the stat beside it reads none), or ztunnel is not scraped. The table beside it names the response flag.

targets.expr: (sum by (cluster) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_failed_total{job="ztunnel", reporter="source", connection_security_policy="mutual_tls", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{job="ztunnel", reporter="source", connection_security_policy="mutual_tls", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{job="ztunnel", reporter="source", connection_security_policy="mutual_tls", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) > 0)

(sum by (cluster) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_failed_total{job="ztunnel", reporter="source", connection_security_policy="mutual_tls", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (cluster) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{job="ztunnel", reporter="source", connection_security_policy="mutual_tls", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m]))) / (sum by (cluster) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{job="ztunnel", reporter="source", connection_security_policy="mutual_tls", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: mTLS connections in the last hour, by source and destination cluster · proposed
panels.description: Proposed: needs the ztunnel scrape job of deploy/. Accepted mTLS connections by where they came from and where they landed, destination side. Both directions between the clusters should have a row while cross-cluster traffic runs.

panels.title: How to read this section

options.content: Traffic outcomes from ztunnel. **Source mTLS connections attempted** reads none when no workload connected: the failure share then has no line, and nothing proves or disproves protection. Allowed, denied and failed connections are on the security events dashboard.

panels.title: Do in-Pod proxies fetch workload certificates at a normal rate? · planned
Workload certificate subscriptions per in-Pod proxy per second · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cmtc/0002 (SPIRE agent telemetry) and the spire-agent and ztunnel scrape jobs of deploy/. Delegated-identity X.509 subscriptions the SPIRE agents served, divided by the in-Pod proxies ztunnel runs, per cluster, 5 minute rate. ztunnel fetches about one certificate a minute per workload; above 0.5 a second per proxy for 10 minutes is the storm of #42 (CMTCSVIDFetchStorm), which loads the SPIRE agent and the node CPU.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (rate({__name__=~"spire_agent_rpc_delegated_identity_subscribe_to_x509_svids(_total)?", job="spire-agent", cluster="cmtc-a"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (cluster) (workload_manager_active_proxy_count{job="ztunnel", cluster="cmtc-a"}), 1)

sum by (cluster) (rate({__name__=~"spire_agent_rpc_delegated_identity_subscribe_to_x509_svids(_total)?", job="spire-agent", cluster="cmtc-b"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (cluster) (workload_manager_active_proxy_count{job="ztunnel", cluster="cmtc-b"}), 1)

panels.title: Certificate subscriptions in the last 5 minutes, by node · planned
panels.description: Planned, a proposed source change: needs source-patches/cmtc/0002 (SPIRE agent telemetry) and the spire-agent and ztunnel scrape jobs of deploy/. Subscriptions per second each node's SPIRE agent served (status OK) and refused (any other status), and the in-Pod proxies on that node. An empty cell: none. On 2026-10-26 between 11:52Z and 11:57Z cmtc-a-worker fetched 3,331 certificates in one minute for 2 workloads (#42).

panels.title: How to read this section

options.content: The SPIRE agent counts its own admin API calls only with telemetry configured, which the lab's SPIRE does not have: source-patches/cmtc/0002 adds it to the configuration scripts/lab/spire/render_spire.py renders, with no SPIRE code change.
